decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - Before the development hereby permitted is commenced a scheme indicating the provision to be made for disabled people to gain access to the guest house shall have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.  The agreed scheme shall be implemented before the development hereby permitted is brought into use.

Condition : 4 - Before first occupation of the buildings the loading, unloading and turning space, and parking spaces (including spaces for people with disabilities) shall be provided within the curtilage of the site in accordance with the scheme shown on drawing No. 06226/02 and such spaces shall be permanently available and not be used for any other purpose.

Condition : 5 - 5.	Before the development commences details of cycle parking shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority and the spaces shown on the approved drawing shall be available for use before first occupation of any part of the development.

Condition : 6 - 56     		Before the development commences details of cycle parking shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority and the spaces shown on the approved drawing shall be available for use before first occupation of any part of the developmentREASON: G2Within three months of the date of this permission a secure storage area within the site enclosed by a two metre high close boarded fence to house one1100 litre galvanised steel Eurobin has been identified and made available, together with facilities for the separation and storage of glass, metal, plastics, cardboard, food waste and other recyclable materials which shall then be collected and taken to a suitable facility for recycling.  The storage area and bin shall be made permanently available before the development is first occupied and no waste shall be stored outside the site or other than in the designated area.  The lid of the Eurobin shall be kept shut at all times other than when waste is being emptied into them.  Non-recyclable and perishable waste shall be removed from site no less frequently than once a week.
description: Continued use of the building as a guest house and change of use of existing garage to a disabled room with a ramp
